description: Did a shipped fix work? Compares the finding's signal before and after the fix, the share of sessions that go on to a next step (click a control, use a form, open a second page), and conversion, the last two against untouched pages (difference-in-differences). Says 'inconclusive' when traffic is too thin. Free.

finding_id.description: Finding id the fix was recorded for

url.description: Scan defects only: test this base URL instead of the live site, e.g. a local dev server running the fix

name: check_fix
